messages:
Priya (AE): Heads-up — Acme Health asked for a bundled quote (API + Optimize + Console add-on) with a 12mo commit and a small POC. Need quick deal-desk approval on cross-product discount and a special term around data handling.
Liam (Solutions): Quick context: POC is 2 weeks, load ~50rps sustained, health-care PHI-ish but they want no retention + KMS. We'll need Private or Dedicated for isolation.
Priya (AE): Proposed commercial: list price combined is $420k/year. Customer asking for net $300k (≈28% blended discount) with 12mo commit. They also want Optimize licensed for 100k eval tokens/month and Console add-on with 5 seats.
Marta (Finance): 28% is high for cross-product. Typical bundle band is 15–22% depending on commit. What’s the upsell runway? Is this ACV or committed spend?
Priya (AE): They're asking committed spend = $300k prepaid over 12 months. ARR recognized monthly. Upsell potential: single-digit expansion to SSO + on-prem later.
Sam (Deal Desk): Tagging @Marta @Jordan — need deal desk sign-off for >20% discount and below-standard commit structure. Also note they want accelerated invoice schedule (Q1 prepay).
Jordan (Legal): Flag on special term: "no data retention beyond request" — we can't alter default retention without a data-processor addendum. Need to pull in security & privacy to confirm language. Also confirm KMS/HSM requirements.
Alex (CS): For the POC we need a checklist. I'll own execution. Requirements: SAML SSO, VPC peering, KMS access for encryption at rest, and a small sample PHI scrubbed dataset. POC success metrics: latency <120ms p50, token cost within 30% of hosted baseline.
Liam (Solutions): For Dedicated sizing: to meet 50rps + Optimize evaluation, recommend 2x A10 pools with burst capacity. That maps to a base ratecard of $X (internal) -> public list we use to derive discount.
Priya (AE): Can we get an exception for 25% blended discount if we trade a 12mo $300k commit + 90-day POC acceptance clause? They want guaranteed rollback if POC fails.
Marta (Finance): 25% might be OK if we add a performance escrow: 60% upfront, 40% on-go-live. Also require annual uplift cap and minimum MRR. Send formal sketch and I'll run model.
Sam (Deal Desk): I'll log this as desk request 2026-DR-487 and attach the rate card and the sketch. Need approval matrix: Marta (Finance) + Jordan (Legal) + Head of Sales (final).
Jordan (Legal): On POC rollback: we can do a clause: "if POC fails to meet the acceptance criteria within 30 days, customer may terminate and Redwood will refund unused prepaid fees prorated to the POC end date, subject to sanitation verification." Need sec/privacy to vet.
Priya (AE): Customer also requested a custom clause: "no model weights or derivatives can be used for general model training." Can Legal sign off or suggest alternate language?
Jordan (Legal): We can offer a data-use limitation: "Customer data will not be used to update Redwood public models; only telemetry for SLOs/ops allowed." That's acceptable with privacy review.
Alex (CS): Operational note for the POC: schedule start two weeks after signed SOW. I'll need an internal ticket for VPC peering + KMS service account.
Marta (Finance): Please include list price, proposed net price, discount %, commit term, payment schedule in the sketch. I'll do a quick IRR/cashflow check.
Liam (Solutions): One technical ask: Optimize activation for 100k eval tokens needs a license flag enabled on tenant; Sam, can Deal Desk ensure license provisioning matches payment milestone?
Sam (Deal Desk): Yes — we'll gate provisioning to receipt of first payment. I'll add licensing note to the request.
Priya (AE): Ok — action items: 1) Sam files deal-desk ticket + attach rate card (Sam) 2) Marta reviews pricing sketch and approves matrix (Marta) 3) Jordan drafts POC/data clauses and loops Privacy (Jordan) 4) Alex schedules POC runbook + infra ticket (Alex) 5) Liam provides Dedicated sizing notes (Liam). I'll loop Acme on a commercial sketch by EOD.
POC-bot: POC checklist created: https://internal/poc/ACME-1782. Items: SSO, VPC, KMS, test dataset, success metrics.
Marta (Finance): I'll target review in 24h. If the model shows NPV positive at 25% discount with 60% upfront, I can clear finance side for approval.
Jordan (Legal): I'll draft the two clauses and run privacy. Expect a draft in ~48h.
Sam (Deal Desk): Ticket filed: 2026-DR-487. Linking rate card v3 and the proposed SOW sketch. I'll ping Head of Sales for final sign-off once Marta & Jordan clear. :thumbsup:
Priya (AE): Thanks all — will post the commercial sketch shortly. :eyes:
